info.name: Typst Editor
info.summary: Collaborative Typst editor with live PDF preview
info.description:
A collaborative Typst editor for Nextcloud that provides real-time editing with CodeMirror, Y.js-based synchronization via Nextcloud Text's backend, and live PDF preview using typst.ts.
## Features
- **Collaborative Editing**: Real-time multi-user editing powered by Y.js and Nextcloud Text's WebSocket server - **CodeMirror Editor**: Full-featured code editor with Typst syntax highlighting - **Live PDF Preview**: Instant PDF rendering in the browser using typst.ts (WASM) - **Split-Pane Interface**: Side-by-side editor and preview with adjustable layout - **DirectEditing Support**: Create new .typ files directly from the Files app
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 31+ - Nextcloud Text app (for Y.js collaboration backend)
